description: This Java class `CumulativeFlatInterestLoanScheduleGenerator` extends an abstract class to generate loan repayment schedules with cumulative flat interest calculations. It utilizes scheduled date generation and payment periods calculation, and includes methods to compute principal and interest components for each period based on loan terms, interest grace periods, and cumulative amounts.

classes.name: CumulativeFlatInterestLoanScheduleGenerator
classes.description: A Spring component that generates cumulative flat interest loan schedules, calculating principal and interest per period considering grace periods and cumulative values.

methods.name: getScheduledDateGenerator
methods.description: Returns the scheduled date generator used for creating payment periods.

methods.name: getPaymentPeriodsInOneYearCalculator
methods.description: Returns the calculator for determining payment periods in one year.

methods.name: calculatePrincipalInterestComponentsForPeriod
methods.description: Calculates principal and interest components for a specific payment period, updating cumulative totals, and adjusting for last repayment periods and grace periods.
